content: Hi all, Axiom just opened up its London office. We are looking to hire Lean experts (Mathlib, and meta-programming) for full-time and internship positions in the UK. If interested, please email your resume and Github link to careers@axiommath.ai and cc jujian@axiommath.ai

Wrenna Robson said:

Would these positions be London-based?

There is an in-person London office and team there. For those who prefer an in-person atmosphere, it can be a perk! :smiley: We also hire for Palo Alto and remote (less openings than Palo Alto or London).
